crossRefs.note: But everyone will die for his own iniquity. Every man who eats the sour grapes, his teeth will be set on edge.
Our fathers sinned, and are no more. We have borne their iniquities.
“What do you mean, that you use this proverb concerning the land of Israel, saying, ‘The fathers have eaten sour…
“As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “you shall not use this proverb any more in Israel.

translations.web: “In those days they will say no more, “ ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children’s teeth are set on edge.’
translations.bsb: “In those days, it will no longer be said: ‘The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the teeth of the children are set on edge.’
translations.kjv: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten a sour grape, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
translations.asv: In those days they shall say no more, The fathers have eaten sour grapes, and the children's teeth are set on edge.
